subject: words
title: Silent letters
about: Words with a letter that makes no sound: the b in lamb, g in gnat, h in hour, l in half, t in listen, s in island, w in sword and n in autumn (kn and wr words have their own levels, and walk and talk are in the tricky levels). CKLA Grade 1 does not teach these as a group and his class says tricky part rather than silent letter, so the quiet letter is marked pink here the way the class underlines it; a step-ahead level for the end of the year, NC RF.1.4.b (decoding) and RF.1.4.g (irregularly spelled words).
tip: Cover the pink letter with a finger and read what is left, then uncover it and say the whole word again.
